description: Additions to the RBI regulator in Mynt's production regulatory model, applied in merge mode (scripts/apply-regulatory-model.mjs merges each regulator into the server's version by id and never drops anything), so it only adds: three customer personas and thirteen obligations on the universal bank licence (rbi_universal_bank), the ones Mynt's reference definitions in schemas/examples/seed/ cite. It assumes the server already has the RBI regulator and that licence, as production does; on a server without them the run is refused. The content is taken from the RBI slice the seed definitions were written against (test/seed-regulatory-model.js), in the register's own schema. Every item is tagged or described as unverified: none has been checked line by line against the current RBI directions (production's own universal bank obligations cite the 2025 KYC directions, these the 2016 master directions), and none carries a legal_ref yet.

customer_personas.name: Resident individual
customer_personas.description: Unverified: kept for Mynt's reference definitions (schemas/examples/seed/). It describes the same people as rbi_retail_individual_resident; check against the RBI's KYC and deposit directions before relying on it.

customer_personas.name: Resident senior citizen
customer_personas.description: Unverified: kept for Mynt's reference definitions (schemas/examples/seed/). Overlaps rbi_senior_citizen_depositor; the age threshold (60) is the one banks commonly use for senior-citizen deposit rates, to verify.

customer_personas.name: Retail (individual) borrower
customer_personas.description: Unverified: kept for Mynt's reference definitions (schemas/examples/seed/). An individual borrowing in a personal capacity.

obligations.title: Customer due diligence and periodic KYC updation
obligations.description: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (2016): identify and verify customers before account-based relationships, screen against sanctions lists, update KYC periodically by risk category.

obligations.title: Transaction monitoring and suspicious transaction reporting
obligations.description: Prevention of Money-laundering Act, 2002 and its rules: monitor transactions and report suspicious ones to FIU-IND.

obligations.title: Interest on deposits
obligations.description: Master Direction - Interest Rate on Deposits (2016): savings interest on the daily balance at quarterly or shorter rests; term deposit rates fixed for the tenor; premature withdrawal at the rate for the period run less a disclosed penalty.

obligations.title: Term deposit terms
obligations.description: Tenor 7 days to 10 years; premature withdrawal available on individuals' deposits up to ₹1 crore; penalty disclosed upfront; unclaimed matured deposits earn the lower of the savings and contracted rate.

obligations.title: Minimum-balance charges
obligations.description: Notify the customer of a shortfall, allow one month to restore it, keep charges proportionate to the shortfall, never let them make the balance negative.

obligations.title: Inoperative accounts and unclaimed deposits
obligations.description: Treat accounts without customer-induced transactions for two years as inoperative, reactivate free, transfer balances unclaimed for ten years to the Depositor Education and Awareness Fund (Banking Regulation Act, section 26A).

obligations.title: Grievance redressal
obligations.description: Board-approved grievance policy; customers may escalate to the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (2021) if not resolved within 30 days.

obligations.title: Key Facts Statement with APR
obligations.description: Retail and MSME loans: a Key Facts Statement with the annual percentage rate and every charge before the contract is executed.

obligations.title: Penal charges in loan accounts
obligations.description: Charge defaults as penal charges, not penal interest; never capitalise them; keep them reasonable and disclosed in the KFS.

obligations.title: Digital lending
obligations.description: Disburse to and collect from the borrower's own bank account directly; offer a cooling-off period to exit without penalty.

obligations.title: Fair practices in recovery
obligations.description: Fair Practices Code: no harassment; recovery contact only between 08:00 and 19:00.

obligations.title: Credit information reporting
obligations.description: Credit Information Companies (Regulation) Act, 2005: membership of every credit information company and regular reporting of borrower data.

obligations.title: Early stress and asset classification
obligations.description: Classify overdue loans as SMA-0, SMA-1 and SMA-2 and as non-performing after 90 days overdue.
